title.narrative: Global Train and Equip Program - Unspecified Activities

description.narrative: The DoD Section 1206 Train and Equip Program builds partnership capacity for time-sensitive, new and emerging counter-terrorist operations and supports military and stability operations in which the US armed forces are a participant. The Special Operations and Low Intensity Conflict-Counter-terrorism (SOLIC-CT) office provides program oversight and established priorities, and the Defense Security Cooperation Agency (DSCA) provides program management. Country teams work through geographic Combatant Commands (COCOMs).
